checks, follow `DEV-STACK-03/06/07` in

new:
**Stacked-PR CI preflight (DEFAULT, repositories that use pull requests).** CRW internal work
opens no pull request and is never stacked (DEV-STACK-01 in `crw-dev`); this preflight is for an
external contribution or a repository whose delivery path is PRs. For stack sizing, repeated runs or
missing checks, follow `DEV-STACK-03/06/07` in
[`crw-dev`'s canonical stack reference](../crw-dev/references/stacked-prs.md).
Ordinary PRs/manual chains are the default. Do not suggest or adopt GitHub
